patch.value:
## Why an exemplar rather than a document

pm-t4d7nz requires that non-PM systems be buildable on pm SDK primitives alone. A requirement stated that way is unfalsifiable until something is built, which is why pm-iiv1gl exists: a content-addressed version-control domain, built on pm primitives, as executable proof.

pm-klxax7 argues that an agent environment is the more demanding proof, and states why: it "needs reset, step, observe and score with reproducibility guarantees, and it therefore functions as the acceptance test for that milestone." A version-control domain exercises the modelling primitives — types, typed edges, invariants, content addressing. An environment exercises those *and* the temporal guarantees: deterministic reset, bounded observation, recorded trajectory, reproducible verdict. The two exemplars are complementary and neither substitutes for the other.

## What it is

A runnable agent environment, in this repository, built exclusively on published SDK surface, exposing four operations.

**Reset** constructs a workspace instance from a seed, byte-identically, on any machine. pm-rbcvt2 shipped this primitive; the exemplar proves it is reachable and sufficient from outside.

**Step** applies an action from a declared action space and records it in the immutable stream. The action space is the environment's declaration, not pm's — pm supplies the mutation primitives and the recording guarantee.

**Observe** returns a bounded observation whose cost was published before the call, per the observation contract.

**Score** returns a verdict computed from recorded state, per the verdict contract, and computes no reward.

## What it is designed to falsify

Every dependency on a CLI command module is a failure of the milestone, not of the exemplar. pm-z5pmf8 already records that the SDK's lifecycle surface re-exports CLI command modules, which means an environment author composing a step today reaches through the CLI layer. The exemplar's build must fail if it imports anything outside the published SDK entrypoints, and that failure is the useful output — it converts "the SDK is complete" from an assertion into a compile error with a name attached.

The same logic applies to each temporal guarantee. If two resets from one seed diverge, the reset primitive is not deterministic and the exemplar says so with a diff. If an observation's measured cost exceeds its published expectation, the observation contract is not honoured. If a verdict recomputed against the same workspace version differs, point-in-time reconstruction is not exact. Each is a mechanical check that no amount of documentation can substitute for.

## Deliberate scope limits

No model, no policy, no training loop, no dependency on any RL framework. The exemplar is the environment side of the boundary and stops where a learner would begin. A trivial scripted policy exercises it in CI — enough to drive a full episode end to end, small enough that it never becomes a machine-learning dependency of this repository.

Small by construction. The value is in what it proves about the substrate, not in the domain it models. A domain elaborate enough to be interesting is a domain elaborate enough to hide a substrate gap behind its own complexity.

## Acceptance shape

One episode, driven end to end in CI on every release candidate: reset from a fixed seed, a scripted action sequence, a bounded observation per step with published cost honoured, a verdict at termination, and a recorded trajectory that replays to the same verdict from the immutable history alone. Two runs on different machines produce byte-identical trajectories. The build fails if any import escapes the published SDK surface.

## Boundaries

Not the beyond-PM exemplar (pm-iiv1gl), which proves the modelling primitives through a version-control domain. This proves the temporal guarantees through an environment. Both report to pm-t4d7nz; neither subsumes the other.

Not the episode substrate (pm-li2fj5), the verdict contract, the observation contract, or episode identity. This exemplar consumes all four and is the acceptance test that they compose — which is why it is the last of the four seams to close, not the first.

Not the scale benchmark harness (pm-mi2x), which measures latency, memory and tokens at 10k, 100k and 1M items. The exemplar may run against those fixtures; it is not a performance instrument.
Agent-environment exemplar: a runnable reset/step/observe/score environment built on published SDK surface alone, as the executable acceptance test for the universal-domain milestone

Fourth of the four seams pm-klxax7 owns. pm-t4d7nz requires that non-PM systems be buildable on SDK primitives alone, which is unfalsifiable until something is built; pm-iiv1gl supplies a content-addressed version-control domain as one proof. The epic argues an environment is the more demanding proof because it exercises the temporal guarantees a modelling domain does not: deterministic reset, bounded observation, recorded trajectory, reproducible verdict. Every import that escapes the published SDK entrypoints is a milestone failure with a name attached -- pm-z5pmf8 already records that the SDK lifecycle surface re-exports CLI command modules, so an author composing a step today reaches through the CLI layer. Deliberately excludes any model, policy, training loop or RL framework dependency. Duplicate check: read pm-iiv1gl, pm-nfrhf0, pm-li2fj5, pm-mi2x, pm-rbcvt2 (closed) and pm-t4d7nz; this exemplar is complementary to pm-iiv1gl and neither subsumes the other.

One episode driven end to end in CI on every release candidate: seeded reset, scripted action sequence, bounded observation per step with published cost honoured, verdict at termination, trajectory replaying to the same verdict from immutable history alone; two runs on different machines produce byte-identical trajectories; the build fails if any import escapes the published SDK entrypoints; no model, policy or RL framework dependency enters this repository
Convert 'the SDK is complete enough to build a foreign domain' from an assertion into a mechanical check
SDK boundary gaps surface as compile errors instead of as author complaints; the universal-domain milestone gains a falsifier
The three other programme seams are now filed; the exemplar is what proves they compose rather than merely coexist
